topic: Who pays for the banner — $259B US digital ad revenue 2024

drafts.text: US digital advertising: $259 billion in 2024, up 15% in a year (IAB/PwC). Growth like that needs raw material, and the raw material is you — unpaid, unpriced, off the books. This is not a crisis. This is a business model. Cookie Roulette: https://data-snack.com/snack/cookie-roulette
